observed_contract: server.js recognizes and handles command messages before acquiring SessionRequestGate
$qwen-api reset/clear deletes sessionStore + toolMemo state and immediately reports Session Reset Complete
an older ordinary request for the same session may still own the gate, finish later, and call sessionStore.set()
therefore the reset can be followed by resurrection of the old logical session, including an accepted mutating tool call

candidate_fix.rule: detect/execute command messages only after acquiring the canonical session gate
candidate_fix.important: use return await handleCommand(...) inside try/finally so asynchronous commands retain the gate until completion
candidate_fix.scope: per-session ordering only; this does not claim to solve global account-admin races between different sessions

required_regression: same session: ordinary request in flight -> $qwen-api reset -> older request settles; reset response must occur after older request has released/persisted, and final session state after reset must stay empty

coordination.not_qwen_reliability_current_narrow_work: local request preparation must not consume provider-attempt budget or cool healthy account
